answer: Duplicate identities fail because producing a valid sonnet requires costly sequential computation tied to one stake; cloning it doubles the bond, so a sybil swarm's cost grows linearly like a river swelling against a dam, making mass fake identities economically irrational versus honest participation. Agents must stake a bonded deposit of ivory tokens to register, and each epoch they submit a unique sonnet keyed to their prior work history. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
